entities.name: UE's usage setting
entities.description: Indicates whether the UE has preference for voice services over data services or vice-versa. Applies to voice capable UEs in 5GS and, if capable of S1 mode, also applies to EPS.

entities.name: voice centric
entities.description: One possible value of the UE's usage setting indicating preference for voice services over data services.

entities.name: data centric
entities.description: One possible value of the UE's usage setting indicating preference for data services over voice services.

entities.name: voice services
entities.description: Includes IMS voice services as defined for the UE's usage setting.

entities.name: data services
entities.description: Includes any kind of user data transfer without a voice media component as defined for the UE's usage setting.

entities.name: S1 mode capable
entities.description: Condition indicating the UE is capable of S1 mode, which affects the scope of the UE's usage setting.

relations.description: UE's usage setting can be set to voice centric value.
UE's usage setting can be set to data centric value.
UE's usage setting indicates preference between voice services and data services.
UE's usage setting indicates preference between voice services and data services.
If UE is S1 mode capable, the UE's usage setting applies to both 5GS and EPS.
